annotations.title: Is this federal contractor's lender marking its loan down?

description: Private credit x federal exposure for one company (name, 12-character UEI or 9-digit EIN): the operating company behind a BDC holdco borrower (resolved through exact name, holdco-stripped name, SAM parent UEI and Form 5500 EIN, with a confidence grade), its federal obligations since FY2025 and DoD FY2024-26 by agency, what every BDC lender marks its first-lien loan at (Jun 30 2026, plus Sep 30 2026 marks pulled from EDGAR as each 10-Q posts), the Q1->Q2 and Q2->Q3 moves, Form 5500 headcount 2024 vs 2025, FCC licenses, turbine aircraft and stress signals. Free: the card. full=true: every lender line with filing link, every recipient UEI, aircraft N-numbers, call signs and up to 17 quarters of mark history with a Tensorust key.

full.description: true returns every linked object and property. Needs a Tensorust key (Authorization: Bearer tdk_...). Omit for the free preview.
